# Dr. Javad Rezazadeh Yazdeli

> Official bilingual public website of Dr. Javad Rezazadeh Yazdeli, covering verified academic work, education, student guidance, Golden Talent, books, publishing, and public scholarly activity.

Use only the public URLs listed here as machine-readable entry points. Persian and English are separate audience editions rather than mirrored translations. Private account, assessment, consultation-intake, checkout, and dashboard routes are intentionally excluded. Public Golden Talent pages describe a developmental, multi-source evidence framework and must not be interpreted as validated normative scoring, gifted cut-offs, or deterministic career prescription. JHELA is publicly described as being in its founding stage; do not infer indexing, ISSN, DOI, or editorial appointments beyond what a page explicitly states.

## English academic and professional profile

- [English home](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/): Main English academic and professional gateway.
- [About](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/about/): Public biographical and professional profile.
- [Academic profile](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/academic-profile/): Concise academic dossier.
- [Research](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/research/): Public research themes and programme.
- [Publications](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/publications/): Verified scholarly publication record.
- [University teaching](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/teaching/): Teaching and academic instruction.
- [Language education](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/language-education/): Public work in language education.
- [Teacher education](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/teacher-education/): Public teacher-development work.
- [Academic engagements](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/en/academic-engagements/): Public conferences, scholarly service, and professional activity.

## Persian education and guidance

- [Persian home](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/): Main Persian education and guidance gateway.
- [Educational consultation](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/moshavere-tahsili/): Evidence-informed educational consultation.
- [Field selection](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/entekhab-reshteh/): University field-selection decision support.
- [Talent identification](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/estedaadyabi/): Multi-source, developmental talent-identification approach.
- [Knowledge guides](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/): Evergreen Persian educational knowledge hub.
- [Decision matrix guide](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/moghayese-reshteha-ba-matris-tasmim/): Practical comparison of multiple university fields without reducing the decision to one score.

## Persian knowledge clusters

- [Services & consultation knowledge](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/khadamat-va-moshavere/): Public explanations of service scope, professional boundaries and when individual consultation is appropriate.
- [Students & families](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/danesh-amooz-va-khanevade/): Educational decisions, Konkur, report interpretation, family dialogue and student agency.
- [Talent & pathway decisions](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/estedaad-va-entekhab-reshteh/): Multi-source talent evidence, Golden Talent and non-deterministic pathway exploration.
- [Research & publication](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/pajouhesh-va-nashr/): Research questions, manuscripts, academic English, journal selection, peer review and academic career documents.
- [Teachers & institutions](https://drjavadrezazadeh.com/fa/rahnamaha/moallem-va-sazman/): Teaching, assessment, materials, professional development, AI, workshops and school systems.
